in_hebrew.name: שִׁינְדֵי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Sindee is derived from the Hebrew word שִׁינְדֵי (shīndēy), which means 'Gift of God'. In the context of the Bible, this name could be given to a child born to a family who has just received a blessing or miracle from God.

in_greek.name: Σινδέη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Sindee in Greek is transliterated as Σινδέη (Sindéē). The meaning of this name is 'Daughter of Fortune'. In ancient Greek culture, this name could be given to a child born to a family who was believed to be favored by the gods.

in_latin.name: Sindea
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Sindee in Latin is transliterated as Sindea. The meaning of this name is 'God's Gift'. In Roman culture, this name could be given to a child born to a family who had just experienced a significant blessing or miracle.
